top_creatures.label: Winged sovereign with a stacked health pool
top_creatures.why: Dragonkin boss tier with the highest dragonkin boss-tier health multiplier (10000; the training-dummy row at 23809 is excluded); a fight-length boss rather than a big-hit boss.
top_creatures.keep: Boss-tier rank and a long, phased fight.
top_creatures.change: No dragon design copied; express health through phases, not one raw multiplier.

top_creatures.label: Quartet of crypt wardens
top_creatures.why: Four linked undead boss-tier rows at level 63 share one encounter; health 100 to 110, damage 15 to 22.5.
top_creatures.keep: Group encounter of four distinct silhouettes.
top_creatures.change: Each warden gets a different element and aura; kill order changes the fight.

top_creatures.label: Stone sentinel and its hard variant
top_creatures.why: Entry 31125 links via difficulty_entry_1 to entry 31722: health 165 becomes 715, damage 36.8 becomes 70.24, same display id 26967. Clearest tier-by-stat-step in the box.
top_creatures.keep: Shared silhouette; roughly 2x health and 2x damage on the hard tier.
top_creatures.change: The hard tier shows its difference (cracks, glow, crown) and gains a phase instead of only bigger numbers.

top_creatures.label: Undead tyrant at the top of the undead damage range
top_creatures.why: Undead boss tier with damage multiplier 492.9 (highest undead boss-tier damage) and health 7397.
top_creatures.keep: A damage ceiling the player can read, with a long telegraph before each heavy hit.
top_creatures.change: Windup and telegraph are our own design; no number-on-a-sheet tuning.

top_creatures.label: Icy beast-lord variant
top_creatures.why: Beast boss tier with damage multiplier 161.8 and health 1300, the highest beast boss-tier damage; the beast family's biggest hitter.
top_creatures.change: Different biome, palette and attack shape.

top_creatures.label: Oversized humanoid commander
top_creatures.why: Humanoid boss tier at scale 3 with health 1000, level 83; a 3x silhouette reads well at 375 wide.
top_creatures.keep: Readable 3x silhouette and a boss-tier pace.
top_creatures.change: No banner and no named-hero look; use a shield-wall aura.

top_creatures.label: Molten colossus
top_creatures.why: Elemental boss tier, level 63, health 330; four spell ids linked (20566, 19773, 19780, 20565) but spell names are not in the box.
top_creatures.change: Crack-glow lines instead of flat lava; different spell set.

top_creatures.label: Demon warlord with the highest demon boss-tier damage
top_creatures.why: Demon boss tier, level 73, damage multiplier 111, the highest demon boss-tier damage multiplier.
top_creatures.change: Original armoured silhouette; keep the damage pattern, not the design.

looks.label: Shared display id across many items
looks.technique: Many items point at one display id (e.g. 6494, 9834), so tiers can come from one model plus a tint or glow.

looks.label: One weapon name, four looks
looks.technique: Same staff name, four entries with four display ids (per-look variants).

looks.label: Creature model roll with probability
looks.technique: A creature picks one of up to 4 weighted models with a scale; 5588 creatures have multiple model rows.

looks.label: Oversized scale for a single boss
looks.technique: Scale 2 to 3 on one boss silhouette; 41 rows at 2.4 and a few at 3.

looks.label: Difficulty tiers via sibling entries
looks.technique: Hard variant shares the model and gets a stat step plus a visual cue; 1804 creatures have difficulty siblings.

looks.label: Heirloom items at item level 1
looks.technique: All heirloom rows carry item level 1 (25 armour, 15 weapon), pointing at a single scaling rule; scaling itself not in the box.

originals.name: Stone warden, two tiers
originals.idea: A bulwark-style boss with a shared silhouette at two difficulties; the hard tier gains a phase.
originals.keep: The sibling link and a roughly 2x stat step.
originals.change: The hard tier gains cracks, glow and a phase; no named-character look.

originals.name: Crypt quartet
originals.idea: Four linked undead bosses, each holding a different element aura; kill order changes the fight.
originals.change: Our own elements and auras; no ability copy.

originals.name: Ember colossus
originals.idea: A slow elemental giant with glowing crack lines that brighten as it takes damage.
originals.change: Crack light instead of flat lava; a different spell set.

originals.name: Oversized commander
originals.idea: A 3x scale humanoid commander with a shield-wall aura that pulses on a readable beat.
originals.change: No banner and no named hero.

originals.name: Gearling swarm
originals.idea: A flock of small mechanical flyers that assemble into a shape.

originals.name: Heirloom blade that grows
originals.idea: A weapon with a level 1 base that gains glow tiers as the player levels.
originals.change: Growth shown by light, not a stat sheet; no existing item name.

originals.name: Storm-chance coast
originals.idea: A coast whose storm odds change per season, with a shimmer warning before each storm.

originals.name: Trap-lined vault
originals.idea: A vault whose traps show through fog as the player nears.
